mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are waking up to clear skies and 65 degrees that feel more like 68, perfect for a walk near Reddan Soccer Park. We have a Waxing Crescent moon tonight, though no space station flyovers are expected.

In city news, Verona is continuing its sustainability push. Apartment residents can compost food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the city is upgrading its transportation fleet with anti-idling ambulance technology and has been recognized as a Bronze Level Bicycle Friendly Community.

Looking at local events, this Sunday, July 19th, features the Mount Horeb Art Fair and live music at Bailey's Run. On Tuesday, July 21st, Hop Haus Brewing and Lake Louie will host trivia nights, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday, July 22nd.

In police news, last Friday morning, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash on Old PB at Whalen Road. A 24-year-old cyclist sustained minor injuries, and a Verona driver was cited for failure to yield the right of way.
Finally, the Verona Culvers is currently closed and will open at 10 AM. Today's delicious flavor of the day is Turtle, and tomorrow you can look forward to Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Crunch.
